All-local-drives caption instead says all physical drives; this can blur local logical volumes with physical devices. Junctions translated 교차점 is a generic intersection rather than precise filesystem wording.
Glob patterns rendered 전역 패턴 means global patterns; light-incidence label 밝기 감소 means brightness decrease. These are terminology findings without rendered UI reproduction.
Sparse action 파일 희소화 remains separate from compression; hardlinks, symbolic links, logical/physical sizes and binary units remain distinct. Account column says security principal.

Most mnemonics use parenthesized Latin letters; no routing/conflict qualification. Cloud warning describes download risk, permanent deletion is not secure-erasure proof; MSI ko-KR/1042/949 needs installer encoding verification.
